adaptation.information_pattern: finite causal game: u chooses from the observed current state; then v observes u and responds before the next state is observed
adaptation.information_pattern_change: the upstream Markov game supplies both actions at one step; sequential response gives v a stronger within-stage information pattern
adaptation.initial_state_override: x1 is set to 2.0; the upstream default is all zeros
adaptation.objective_orientation: u minimizes the terminal absolute position gap (maximizes the source reward); v maximizes the gap
adaptation.quantization: round each outer RK4 state to the nearest 1e-6 lattice point
adaptation.scope: source-derived finite catalogue and quantized state graph; not a continuous-action RL reproduction

numerical_assurance: numerical; finite double-precision RK4 transitions rounded to the declared 1e-6 state lattice

target.set: abs(x1-x2) <= 1.0 at the selected terminal stage
